scope: T039 基礎天氣與露天澆水；並非完整四季與氣候系統
clock: existing authoritative saved world time; paused with no players; no real-time offline catch-up
watering: calendar-day wetness; expires at midnight, rain re-wets exposed cultivated plots
shelter: roof-covered cells and mine_1 through mine_5 do not receive rain
presentation: snapshot time only; reduced-motion disables moving rain without changing water/growth
compatibility: crop IDs and wet/growth fields unchanged; existing wet plots treated as watered for the current saved game day
limits: provisional shared outdoor weather; not a Taiwan climate simulation
seasons, wind resources, snow, quality and crop seasonal dormancy remain open
midnight watering expiry is calendar-day semantics, not 1440 seconds after each watering action
